title: Mode Behavior-Profile System
notes: 5 modes (ambient/focus/silent/assistant/meeting), data-driven profiles, runtime voice-switchable via set_mode tool, execution-time tool-deny gate. Phase 0 spike + Phase 4b schema-strip are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this PRD (deferred follow-ups per ADR); execution-time deny ships independently. focus/silent/ambient timing+sound must be characterization-pinned (no regression).

stories.title: ModeProfile dataclass + registry (src/agent/modes.py)
stories.rationale: Data-driven profiles so new modes are data not code; fail-safe to AMBIENT.
acceptanceCriteria: src/agent/modes.py defines frozen dataclass ModeProfile(name:str, prompt_addendum:str, denied_tool_patterns:tuple[str,...], turn_timeout:float, sound_policy, proactivity:str)
MODE_PROFILES dict has exactly keys: ambient, focus, silent, assistant, meeting
ambient/focus/silent profiles carry turn_timeout + sound_policy equal to CURRENT behavior
meeting denied_tool_patterns blocks bash, write, edit, stop_daemon, restart_daemon, and patterns 'mcp__*' and 'macos-use*'; assistant denies nothing
resolve(name) returns the matching ModeProfile; unknown/empty returns ambient profile and logs a warning
is_tool_allowed(profile, tool_name) returns False on denied glob match else True; 'set_mode' ALWAYS True regardless of profile
uv run pytest tests/test_modes.py exits 0
stories.evidence: verified: per-story tests green + full suite 1232 passed

stories.title: SessionState composition wrapper
stories.rationale: Single source of truth; compose (not absorb) the untouched LanguageState to avoid language-switch regression.
acceptanceCriteria: src/pipeline/session_state.py defines SessionState holding a reference to an existing LanguageState plus a current ModeProfile
SessionState.profile returns the live ModeProfile; SessionState.set_mode(name) resolves via modes.resolve and updates it, firing its OWN mode-change listener separate from LanguageState's
SessionState exposes register_flush_hook(callable) and flush_pending() for the set_mode tool to force-submit the turn buffer
src/pipeline/language_state.py is unmodified (git diff empty for that file)
SessionState seeded from settings.mode at construction
uv run pytest tests/test_session_state.py exits 0
stories.evidence: verified: per-story tests green + full suite 1232 passed

stories.title: Execution-time tool-deny gate at handler chokepoints
stories.rationale: Tools register once but modes switch at runtime; gate at execution time. Same seam as future audio-bleed gate.
acceptanceCriteria: schemas.py _make_handler and mcp_bridge handler accept SessionState and at entry check is_tool_allowed(session_state.profile, tool_name)
Denied => result_callback {success:False, output:'', error:'<tool> is unavailable in <mode> mode'} and execute_direct/session.call_tool NOT called
Denied path records a conversation_manager action when present and logs a line containing 'mode_gate' with tool and mode
Allowed path behavior byte-identical to before
register_all_tools and McpBridge.register accept session_state; build.py constructs SessionState before register_all_tools AND before connect_mcp_servers/McpBridge.register and passes it
uv run pytest tests/test_mode_tool_gate.py exits 0
stories.evidence: verified: per-story tests green + full suite 1232 passed

stories.title: set_mode tool with buffer flush
stories.rationale: Runtime voice switching; flush pending turn buffer before switching so mid-sentence speech is not dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: registry.py + schemas.py register a set_mode tool with arg 'mode' (string); _execute_set_mode in direct.py
Invalid mode name => success:False with spoken-legible error listing valid modes; valid => success:True confirmation naming the mode
Valid switch calls session_state.flush_pending() BEFORE session_state.set_mode(), writes mode_file, updates live SessionState
Test asserts is_tool_allowed(meeting_profile,'set_mode') is True (exempt in every mode)
uv run pytest tests/test_set_mode_tool.py exits 0
stories.evidence: verified: per-story tests green + full suite 1232 passed

stories.title: Wire-ins: turn_aggregator, indication, prompt addendum
stories.rationale: Mode must actually drive timing, sound, and prompt behavior via the single SessionState.
acceptanceCriteria: turn_aggregator turn-timeout selection reads SessionState.profile.turn_timeout instead of the hardcoded focus/ambient branch
indication sound gating reads SessionState.profile.sound_policy instead of hardcoded _mode_allows_sound; SILENT/FOCUS/AMBIENT semantics preserved
context_injector renders active profile.prompt_addendum AND a one-line available-mode list into the system prompt via the context dict
build.py constructs SessionState and threads it to turn_aggregator, indication mode_provider, and the system prompt injector
uv run pytest tests/test_mode_wireins.py exits 0
stories.evidence: verified: per-story tests green + full suite 1232 passed
